words.example: May I add one point on staffing?
words.exampleZh: 我能补充一句人手的事吗？

words.example: Please continue from the last slide.
Scavenging removed stale address records from the ward DNS zone last night.
words.exampleZh: 过期记录清理昨晚从病区 DNS 区域删掉了过时的地址记录。

words.example: Aging marks old host records so they can be removed later.
words.exampleZh: 记录老化会标出旧的主机记录，方便以后删除。

words.example: A dynamic update registered the new clinic computer in DNS this morning.
words.exampleZh: 今天早上，一次动态更新把新的门诊电脑登记进了 DNS。

words.example: A secure update requires the computer to prove its domain identity first.
words.exampleZh: 安全更新要求电脑先证明自己的域身份。

words.example: The zone transfer failed when the secondary server rejected the request.
words.exampleZh: 辅助服务器拒绝了请求，区域传送因此失败。
